Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program

Provider: Mastercard Foundation

Degree: scholarships at the secondary, undergraduate, and master's levels. Scholarships are not currently available to PhD candidates.

Field of study: programs across partner institutions

Funding Type: Financial support includes, but is not limited to, tuition fees, accommodation, books and other academic materials, and a return air ticket

Eligible Nationalities: young African leaders pursuing higher education

Country of study: partner institutions primarily in Africa, with partners in North America and Europe

Eligibility criteria: apply through one of the partner universities. Each partner sets their own deadline.

Deadline: Each partner sets their own deadline

Where to apply - partner universities Partner university Master's scholarships
